## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the `--exclude` default so CI can configure exclusions through the environment as project policy requires.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files by basename and logs each skip at info level. It documents the flag and adds tests for argument parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser still returns `[]`. The CLI flags policy requires that every added flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment will include files they intended to omit.
